id.description: Stable across retries. It is the dedupe key.

event.description: The event name, the same vocabulary docs/WEBHOOKS.md 8.2 defines.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival.

payload.description: The event body as a JSON string, so one batch can carry several event shapes without this document depending on all of them.

started_at.description: RFC3339 UTC. Process start, so the control plane can tell a restart from a network gap.

observed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC. When the node built this body, not when it was received.

desired_revision_applied.description: The last revision this node applied transactionally under its current enrollment, 0 when none. The control plane resends until this matches.

admission.description: Whether this node admits new publishes and jobs. draining is in place with the process up (D3).

revocations_digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the revocation list in force: sorted, deduplicated, newline-joined, no trailing newline (docs/API.md 15.2). The control plane resends the desired state at the same revision when this differs from the digest of the list it intends.

desired_revision_rejected.description: The newest revision this node refused and why, or null when the latest revision it was sent applied.

events.description: A BOUNDED batch from the durable fleet queue. Bounded by count and by bytes: a receiver that was down for a day must not be answered with a day of history in one body.

acked_command_ids.description: Ids of commands this node has completed. A command is re-sent until its id appears here.

jobs_pause.description: The jobs pause in force on this node, or null when none is active. Read from the committed journal row, so the first beat after a restart already carries it. Set by the control plane (source fleet), or by the pause route before the box joined (source api) until the first desired-state revision replaces it.

until.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when the pause ends by itself; null until cleared.

source.description: fleet: the control plane's desired state. api: PUT /api/v1/transcode/pause on the box.

disk_floor_breached.description: true means free space is below limits.disk_floor_gb. The node reports and alerts; it does not delete an unregistered archive to clear it.

outbox_depth.description: Undelivered webhook rows. A rising depth with a healthy node means the RECEIVER is down.

recordings_unregistered.description: Finalized artifacts still waiting on registration. tmesis leave refuses while this is non-zero (final plan 11.19).

epoch.description: The KEY epoch the attached publisher authenticated with, never the session epoch (API.md 8.3); it pairs with min_key_epoch in the re-keying workflow. 0 when nothing is attached, and for a legacy bare key, which carries none.

dual_accept.description: true means the attached producer is still on a legacy bare key and needs re-keying.
